about: Jobs the app can ask Claude to do straight away, through the helper (apps/server). The app sends only the job's name; these words are what Claude follows. See maintainers/SHARED-V4-CHANGES.md.

scan-my-skills.label: scanning your skills
scan-my-skills.prompt: The person has pressed Scan in Skill and Folder Map OS. Follow .claude/skills/scan-my-skills: run the scan script (node apps/skill-map/scan/scan.js, or python3 apps/skill-map/scan/scan.py if Node isn't installed) once, then stop. Change nothing else.

group-my-skills.label: grouping your skills by what they do
group-my-skills.prompt: The person has pressed Group in Skill and Folder Map OS. Follow .claude/skills/group-my-skills for every skill in apps/skill-map/data/skillmap.json that isn't in an area yet. Read context/business.md first if it exists. Change nothing else.

review-my-skills.label: reviewing your skills
review-my-skills.prompt: The person has pressed Review in Skill and Folder Map OS. Follow .claude/skills/review-my-skills: read apps/skill-map/data/skillmap.json and add suggestions to its recommendations list. Only suggest: never edit, move or delete a skill. Change nothing else.

scan-my-folders.label: looking through your folders
scan-my-folders.prompt: The person has pressed Scan in the Folders map in Skill and Folder Map OS. Follow .claude/skills/scan-my-folders: run the folder scan script (node apps/skill-map/scan/scan-files.js, or python3 apps/skill-map/scan/scan-files.py if Node isn't installed) once, then stop. Change nothing else.

review-my-folders.label: reviewing your folders
review-my-folders.prompt: The person has pressed Review in the Folders map in Skill and Folder Map OS. Follow .claude/skills/review-my-folders: read apps/skill-map/data/filemap.json and add suggestions to its recommendations list. Only suggest: never move, rename, edit or delete a file or folder. Change nothing else.

tidy-up.label: tidying up
tidy-up.prompt: The person has pressed a Fix button in Skill and Folder Map OS and has already seen and agreed to what it will do. Follow .claude/skills/tidy-up: work out the moves for any item that asks you to, run the tidy-up script once (node apps/skill-map/tidy/tidy.js, or python3 apps/skill-map/tidy/tidy.py if Node isn't installed), then run the matching scan once so the map is up to date. If the script is not allowed to run, stop and say the tidy-up is waiting for the person to approve it. Never delete anything, never move anything yourself, change nothing else.
